notes.TWN: V-Dem 的台灣：1900–1944 年是日本統治下的台灣，1945–1948 年是設在大陸的中華民國政府，1949 年起是遷台的中華民國。1900 年以前沒有另外評分。
notes.CHN: 1789–1910 年是清朝，1911–1948 年是中華民國（北洋政府、國民政府），1949 年起是中華人民共和國。
notes.DEU: 1789–1866 年是普魯士，1867–1870 年是北德意志邦聯，1871 年起是德意志帝國；巴伐利亞、薩克森、符騰堡等邦在併入以前另外評分，地圖上沒有它們的形狀，所以沒有放。1949–1990 年是西德（V-Dem 把聯邦德國當成德國的延續）；東德另外評分，地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。1945–1948 年盟軍占領，沒有評分。
notes.RUS: 1789–1916 年是俄羅斯帝國。1918–1990 年是蘇聯（V-Dem 把蘇聯算在俄羅斯）；其他加盟共和國 1990 年起才有評分。
notes.SRB: 1918–1991 年是南斯拉夫王國、南斯拉夫社會主義聯邦共和國，1992–2005 年是南斯拉夫聯盟共和國、塞爾維亞與蒙特內哥羅。
notes.VNM: 1945–1975 年是北越（越南民主共和國）；南越（越南共和國）另外評分，地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。
notes.YEM: 1918–1989 年是北葉門；南葉門（1990 年以前）另外評分，地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。
notes.TZA: 尚吉巴（1964 年起是坦尚尼亞的半自治區）另外評分，地圖上沒有它的形狀，所以沒有放。
notes._SOL: 1900–1959 年是英屬索馬利蘭，1991 年起是自行宣布獨立的索馬利蘭共和國；1960–1990 年屬於索馬利亞，沒有另外評分。
notes.SOM: 1900–1959 年是義屬索馬利蘭（1950 年起是聯合國託管地）；1991 年起不含自行宣布獨立的索馬利蘭（另外評分，地圖上是另一個形狀）。
notes.PSE: V-Dem 把約旦河西岸與加薩走廊分開評分，這裡用約旦河西岸的值；加薩走廊 2025 年是 -0.94。
notes.ITA: 1861 年義大利王國成立起才有評分；在那之前的薩丁尼亞-皮埃蒙特、兩西西里、教宗國、托斯卡尼等另外評分，地圖上沒有它們的形狀，所以沒有放。

notesEn.TWN: V-Dem's Taiwan: Taiwan under Japanese rule in 1900–1944, the Republic of China government on the mainland in 1945–1948, and the Republic of China in Taiwan from 1949. Not scored separately before 1900.
notesEn.CHN: Qing China in 1789–1910, the Republic of China (Beiyang and Nationalist governments) in 1911–1948, and the People's Republic of China from 1949.
notesEn.DEU: Prussia in 1789–1866, the North German Confederation in 1867–1870 and the German Empire from 1871; Bavaria, Saxony, Württemberg and other states are scored separately until they joined and have no shape on today's map, so they are not shown. 1949–1990 is West Germany (V-Dem treats the Federal Republic as the continuation of Germany); East Germany is scored separately and has no shape on today's map, so it is not shown. 1945–1948 (Allied occupation) is not scored.
notesEn.RUS: The Russian Empire in 1789–1916. 1918–1990 is the Soviet Union (V-Dem scores the USSR as Russia); the other Soviet republics are scored only from 1990.
notesEn.SRB: 1918–1991 is the Kingdom of Yugoslavia and socialist Yugoslavia; 1992–2005 the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and Serbia and Montenegro.
notesEn.VNM: 1945–1975 is North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam); South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) is scored separately and has no shape on today's map, so it is not shown.
notesEn.YEM: 1918–1989 is North Yemen; South Yemen (before 1990) is scored separately and has no shape on today's map, so it is not shown.
notesEn.TZA: Zanzibar (a semi-autonomous region of Tanzania since 1964) is scored separately and has no shape on the map, so it is not shown.
notesEn._SOL: British Somaliland in 1900–1959 and the self-declared Republic of Somaliland from 1991; part of Somalia in 1960–1990 and not scored separately.
notesEn.SOM: Italian Somaliland in 1900–1959 (a UN trust territory from 1950); from 1991 Somaliland, which declared independence, is scored separately (it has its own shape on the map).
notesEn.PSE: V-Dem scores the West Bank and the Gaza Strip separately; the West Bank is shown here. Gaza in 2025: -0.94.
notesEn.ITA: Scored from the founding of the Kingdom of Italy in 1861; Piedmont-Sardinia, the Two Sicilies, the Papal States, Tuscany and other earlier states are scored separately and have no shape on today's map, so they are not shown.
